name: constant-reader
description: A theme for Stephen King fans: The Mist / Shine / Dark Tower stat bars, spinner verbs, tips, soft sounds and a break timer.

mistThreshold.title: Mist threshold (%)
mistThreshold.description: Context fill at which the mist gets thick and asks for a /compact or handoff.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Play a soft typewriter bell when a turn ends and a chime when a permission is needed.
